about: The play-i tree: what the signal learns across hosts. Hidden from the player; after each death they are offered 2 random nodes whose requirements are met. requires = any one of the listed nodes.

branches.name: Locomotion
branches.theme: How far and how freely the signal can drive a body

branches.name: Processing
branches.theme: Running hotter, cooling faster, acting twice

branches.name: Grafting
branches.theme: Getting more from implants, for less

branches.name: Signal
branches.theme: Staying alive and carrying more into each host

branches.name: Network
branches.theme: Working with allies (offered once the first ally is unlocked)

nodes.name: Gait calibration
nodes.effect: +1 movement (1 to 2 tiles)

nodes.name: Reflex loop
nodes.effect: After attacking, you can still move 1 tile if you haven't moved

nodes.name: Sure footing
nodes.effect: Hazards deal half damage to you

nodes.name: Long stride
nodes.effect: +1 movement (2 to 3 tiles)

nodes.name: Sidestep
nodes.effect: The first heavy attack aimed at you each fight misses

nodes.name: Phase step
nodes.effect: Move through enemies and obstacles

nodes.name: Heat sink
nodes.effect: Shed 3 more heat each round (6 to 9)

nodes.name: Cold start
nodes.effect: Start each fight at 0 heat instead of 20

nodes.name: Thermal tolerance
nodes.effect: Take less extra damage when hot (hot x1.25 to x1.10, critical x1.75 to x1.40)

nodes.name: Overclocked core
nodes.effect: Act twice at 25 heat or below (was 15)

nodes.name: Vent
nodes.effect: Brace cools 10 more

nodes.name: Runaway
nodes.effect: You can move at 100 heat, and critical heat crits 45% of the time (was 30%)

nodes.name: Targeting
nodes.effect: +10% damage

nodes.name: Fifth slot
nodes.effect: A fifth action slot on your fight bar

nodes.name: Flank logic
nodes.effect: Flanking bonuses +50% (behind 30% to 45%, side 15% to 22%)

nodes.name: Clean first strike
nodes.effect: Your first attack each fight is precise

nodes.name: Finisher
nodes.effect: +25% damage against enemies under 30% health

nodes.name: Chain
nodes.effect: Taking down an enemy gives you another action

nodes.name: Clean interface
nodes.effect: Implant health costs are halved

nodes.name: Reinforced housings
nodes.effect: +25% structure

nodes.name: Salvage instinct
nodes.effect: Each new host starts with a random common active implant

nodes.name: Graft memory
nodes.effect: Each new host starts with 2 upgrade points

nodes.name: Pick of the wreck
nodes.effect: When a win drops an implant, choose 1 of 2

nodes.name: Self-repair
nodes.effect: Brace repairs 80% of structure (was 40%)

nodes.name: Signal strength
nodes.effect: +20 max health

nodes.name: Stim cache
nodes.effect: Each new host starts with 2 Bio-Stims

nodes.name: Haggler
nodes.effect: Grey Lane prices are 20% lower

nodes.name: Holdfast
nodes.effect: Once per host, a killing blow leaves you on 1 health instead

nodes.name: Deep signal
nodes.effect: +40 max health

nodes.name: Hardened signal
nodes.effect: Take 10% less damage from everything

nodes.name: Handshake
nodes.effect: Allies start each fight with 25% more health

nodes.name: Shared memory
nodes.effect: Allies earn experience twice as fast

nodes.name: Coordinated
nodes.effect: +20% damage against an enemy your ally hit this round

nodes.name: Second link
nodes.effect: Bring two allies into a run
